title: The Bell That Would Not Rest

chapters.title: The Missing Bell
chapters.body:
Kuro returns to a silent monastery.
Captain Ren has taken its shrine bell.
Follow the old causeway before night closes in.

chapters.title: An Order in Embers
chapters.body:
The gatekeepers still obey Ren.
His stolen bell commands their burning limbs.
Clear the courtyard and open the next shrine.

chapters.title: Keepers Without Rest
chapters.body:
The floating spirits were shrine keepers.
Ren's binding has taken their bodies.
Their release lies beyond the bamboo wall.

chapters.title: The Captain's Road
chapters.body:
Every opened shrine weakens the binding.
Kuro follows the roof path toward the keep.
Ren's last guards are waiting above.

chapters.title: A Broken Oath
chapters.body:
Ren swore to protect this sanctuary.
He bound its keepers to keep its fires alive.
Kuro must end the oath that became a prison.

chapters.title: Let the Bell Rest
chapters.body:
Ren stands between Kuro and the bell.
Defeat the captain and break his binding.
Give the keepers back their silence.
chapters.objective: Defeat Ren and free the keepers.

ending.title: The First Quiet Morning
ending.body:
Ren falls. The bell finally rests.
The keepers' flames fade into morning mist.
Kuro carries the bell home.
